summary.text: Candice White is a Democratic state representative from Vermont's Washington-2 District who has served since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A communications consultant, she previously worked in magazine publishing and resort marketing.

paragraphs.text: Candice White was born in Clinton, New York, graduated from Ravenscroft School, and earned a bachelor's degree from Boston College in 1991.

Her career experience includes serving as marketing director and director of new media for The Atlantic Monthly Magazine, publisher of The American Prospect Magazine, and marketing director and vice president of communications, guest service and brand for Sugarbush Resort.
She has been affiliated with the Central Vermont Economic Development Corporation and the Vermont Women's Fund.
White assumed office on January 8, 2025, and advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
